reportsPage.title: Security Reports
reportsPage.description: Generate aggregated security reports for your organization, teams, or custom project selections.

owasp.title: About OWASP Top 10
owasp.description: The OWASP Top 10 is a standard awareness document representing a broad consensus about the most critical security risks to web applications. It helps developers and security teams prioritize and address common vulnerabilities like injection attacks, broken authentication, and sensitive data exposure.

cwe.title: About CWE Top 25
cwe.description: The CWE Top 25 Most Dangerous Software Weaknesses is a list compiled by MITRE that identifies the most widespread and critical weaknesses in software. It provides a common language for describing security flaws and helps organizations focus on eliminating root causes of vulnerabilities.

license.title: About License Report
license.description: The License Report provides visibility into the open source licenses used across your projects. It helps identify licensing compliance risks by categorizing packages as Permissive, Weak Copyleft, Strong Copyleft, or Unknown.
